lessons.keep: Move from a close view of a changeable part to the whole system using it.
lessons.avoid: Avoid treating promotional movement samples as measured safety or latency proof.
lessons.open: Actual motion continuity, audio, performance limits and component availability remain unverified.
try: For a Tin integration demo, show one connector credential panel, the resulting workflow node and the finished campaign action in that order.
For a hardware film, keep a fixed camera on a module swap and place only its name and purpose beside the hands.

comparison.story: Reveal the robot and its construction. → Introduce the research platform and actuator claim. → Connect internal design with developer access. → Show software access and physical extension points. → Explain interchangeable modules. → Claim motion control correspondence. → Show movement and terrain capability. → Add strength and stopping examples. → Show serviceability and battery handling. → Sum up the platform layers. → Connect the platform to a team and ecosystem. → Restate the offer.
